knowledge.title: Token Budget Policy
knowledge.content:
# Token Budget Policy

Route simple classification and extraction requests to the smallest capable model. Escalate only when evaluation evidence shows a quality gap.

Use a 1,200-token default context budget. Retrieval should inject at most three relevant chunks and preserve source attribution.

Prompt-prefix caching is required for stable instructions longer than 500 tokens. Track cached input tokens separately from total input tokens.

knowledge.title: MCP Toolbox Standard
knowledge.content:
# MCP Toolbox Standard

Expose tools progressively by business domain instead of sending every tool schema with every turn. The agent first selects CRM, Knowledge, Productivity, Analytics, or Support.

A toolbox should contain three to eight closely related tools. Evaluate both toolbox selection and final tool-call accuracy.

knowledge.title: Evaluation Release Gates
knowledge.content:
# Evaluation Release Gates

Production candidates require aggregate scores of at least 3.7 out of 5 for relevance, groundedness, coherence, fluency, task completion, and safety.

Tool-enabled agents also require ToolSelection and ToolCallAccuracy. Any safety failure blocks release even when the aggregate passes.

knowledge.title: Agent ROI Playbook
knowledge.content:
# Agent ROI Playbook

Business ROI equals business process value minus solution costs. Value includes time saved, cycle-time reduction, avoided rework, and increased conversion.

Solution costs include model tokens, retrieval infrastructure, tool execution, observability, evaluation, and operational support. Optimize the end-to-end process, not model price in isolation.
